PathOfBuilding.Notes:
For Min/Max Final version or God Tier version Uber Boss ONLY farming (Do NOT use for mapping), swap: Earthshatter -> Perforate of Duality Pulverize -> Conc Effect
Stay in Sand Stance while uber boss is in immunity phase. Right before uber boss becomes attackable, swap to blood stance. This will give you 4 seconds of 15x Perforate spikes. Larger bosses get hit by all. Sirus probably only about half, but still absurd dps, like 350million+.
